countRules: 126 planned finite HTTP requests; 2 additional raw CONNECT peers. Counts are plans, not observations. Record dispatch, headers/body availability, actual complete responses, partials and cleanup separately; failure never synthesizes scheduled success. Outer bound is per selected callback command, not a claim the whole suite finishes in 120s.
peerObservationRule: I18/I19 record actual refusal bytes and peer state/close chronology before shutdown. Already normal-closed stays already closed. Claim shutdown-forced destruction only for observed live owned transport plus observed closure; otherwise refusal/cleanstop/reopen only. No sleep/retry/new seam or transport change, and no inference that RU and TX share the same socket lifecycle.
